draft.title: Asphalt Shingle Roofing in Caulfeild
draft.summary: We installed architectural asphalt shingles on a 2200 square foot roof in Caulfeild, replacing damaged deck boards and fixing a faulty bathroom fan vent.

sections.body: The roof was a twenty year old shingle roof with lifting tabs on the south slope and a soft spot in the deck above the kitchen.
The crew found two rotten deck boards under the south slope and a bathroom fan that had been venting straight into the attic.
We replaced the two rotten deck boards, ran the bathroom fan through the roof with a proper cap, laid new underlayment and installed architectural shingles.
The attic is dry and the fan now exhausts outside. The owners had no leaks in the first big October storm.

draft.title: Metal Roof Replacement in Ambleside
draft.summary: We replaced a leaking metal roof in Ambleside with new standing seam panels and repaired the chimney cricket.

sections.body: The roof was a metal roof that had started to leak at the chimney and along one eave.
Wind blew hard every afternoon, limiting work to mornings, and the chimney cricket had been built too small.
We rebuilt the chimney cricket, replaced the failed eave flashing and installed new standing seam panels cut to length.
The roof stayed dry through the next four rain days and the owners kept the photographs of the new cricket.

draft.title: Cedar Roof Replacement in British Properties
draft.summary: We replaced a deteriorating cedar roof with new cedar shakes, improving water shedding and long-term upkeep.

sections.body: The roof was a thirty year old cedar roof heavily covered in moss with several split shakes near the valley.
The north side stayed wet under tall trees so we had to wait two days for the deck to dry before laying new shakes.
We removed the old shakes, replaced damp deck boards, installed a ventilated underlayment and laid new cedar shakes.
The roof sheds water properly and the owners have a one page upkeep checklist.

draft.title: Flat Roof Repair in Dundarave with TPO Membrane
draft.summary: A flat roof over a rear room was repaired with a new TPO membrane and tapered insulation to improve drainage and prevent leaks.

sections.body: The roof had an old membrane that had split along the wall and let water in.
Water had pooled near the drain because the roof had almost no fall.
We added tapered insulation toward the drain, fastened a new white membrane and welded every seam.
Water now drains away within a few hours of rain.

draft.title: Skylight Leak Repair in Ambleside
draft.summary: A leaking skylight in Ambleside was repaired by rebuilding the curb flashing and testing with a hose.

sections.body: A skylight that leaked only in wind driven rain, with a brown stain on the ceiling below.
The leak was hard to reproduce, and water entered at the lower corners of the curb.
We lifted the shingles around it, rebuilt the curb flashing and shingled back in, then tested with a hose.
No leak since the repair.

draft.title: Composite slate roofing in British Properties with detailed valleys
draft.summary: We installed composite slate roofing in British Properties, carefully planning valleys to address leaks and improve detail.

sections.body: The roof had several valleys and old leaks at two of them.
The valleys met at awkward angles, requiring careful planning of the tile layout before ordering.
We drew every valley on the deck first, installed open valleys and laid composite slate in even courses.
The valleys are now the most carefully detailed part of the roof.

draft.title: Solar Installation on a South Facing Slope in Caulfeild
draft.summary: We installed a solar array on a south facing slope in Caulfeild, replacing damaged shingles and ensuring the roof could support the system long-term.

sections.body: The roof was a ten year old shingle roof on a south facing slope with good sun above the trees.
We had to decide whether the roof could carry the array for its whole life.
We inspected the deck and shingles, replaced two damaged courses and flashed every mount into the rafters before the panels went on.
The array covers the south slope and the roof under it is documented with photos.
